notes: Variant assumption is a two-leg standing bodyweight box jump with countermovement takeoff, landing on the box, and step-down return. Exact box-jump EMG is limited, so gluteus maximus is supported by exact performance studies plus close vertical-jump EMG and biomechanics rather than exact glute EMG from a box-jump-only paper. No trunk or adductor visible support roles were added because the evidence did not justify a concise local anatomy classification. No anatomy blockers found.
